subject.title: Agent confabulates completed actions on Telegram surface — same config works reliably on Claude Code/Codex

question: Should OpenClaw core add a narrow outbound runId/delivery-correlation seam for verifier plugins, or should this issue stay entirely in ClawHub/plugin scope under the existing hook contracts?
rationale: The observable problem is user-facing, but broad claim verification is optional policy that VISION.md pushes out of core unless a concrete plugin API gap blocks implementation.

options.title: Plugin Policy Plus Narrow Seam
options.body: Keep claim-verification behavior outside core, but allow a focused core API fix if plugin proof shows exact-turn outbound correlation is currently impossible.

options.title: Plugin Only
options.body: Treat the closed broad verifier discussion as final and ask affected deployments to publish or install a ClawHub verifier using sessionKey-based correlation.

options.title: Core Verifier
options.body: Make OpenClaw own built-in success-claim verification despite the new policy/config and upgrade-safety surface.

recommendation.title: Plugin Policy Plus Narrow Seam
recommendation.body: Keep claim-verification behavior outside core, but allow a focused core API fix if plugin proof shows exact-turn outbound correlation is currently impossible.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete made the closest recorded boundary decision on the broad verifier request and is the strongest signal for plugin scope versus core policy.
